questions.explanation: Professor JR Hicks, in his book "A Contribution to the Theory of the Trade Cycle" (1950), based his theory of the business cycle on the basis of the law of multiplier-accelerator interaction. In which he has used some important elements – desired rate of growth, consumption function, autonomous and investment induced investment function and multiplier interrelationship (super multiplier, lever effect). Their business cycle begins with autonomous investment. Increase in the rate of autonomous investment activates the multiplier, due to which induced investment increases, as a result of which income starts increasing and due to the combined working of multiplier- accelerator, the economy moves towards growth, i.e. the economy is in growth stage. Multipliers-accelerators work together in one direction. Due to which the economy reaches the stage of full employment. But in deceleration state only multiplier works and while accelerator works almost zero or not at all.
